title: Langtang: road to Syabrubesi cut by the August 2026 flood
text: The Bhote Koshi flood of 26 August 2026 badly damaged Syabrubesi and the road to it. Reports in mid-November 2026 said vehicles were stopping at Dhunche or Thulo Syabru, with the Langtang valley and Gosaikunda trails open again from there. The Tamang Heritage Trail runs through the worst-hit area and its status was unclear.
action: Confirm the current roadhead and which bridges are in use with your agency or a lodge owner before you book transport.

title: Manaslu and Tsum: flood damage in the Budhi Gandaki gorge
text: A flood on 11 October 2026 destroyed bridges and stretches of trail between Machha Khola and Philim and in lower Tsum. Temporary bypasses were reported on the Manaslu Circuit in the weeks that followed; access to Tsum was still uncertain when we last checked.
action: Ask your agency for the state of the gorge trail and the Tsum junction this week, and do not set out in or just after heavy rain.
